question: What is the return policy window for items purchased online?
ground_truth: Items purchased online can be returned within 30 days of delivery for a full refund, provided they are in their original, unused condition with all tags attached.
contexts: Our standard return policy allows customers to return products within 30 days of delivery. Items must be undamaged, unwashed, and include original packaging and tags for a full refund to the original payment method.

question: How long does standard domestic shipping take to arrive?
ground_truth: Standard domestic shipping typically takes 3 to 5 business days to arrive after processing.
contexts: Orders shipped via Standard Shipping arrive within 3-5 business days. Express shipping is delivered within 1-2 business days.

question: Can I cancel or change an order after it has been placed?
ground_truth: Orders can only be modified or canceled within 1 hour of placing the order before it enters the warehouse fulfillment stage.
contexts: You may cancel or edit your order within 60 minutes of placing it by visiting your Account Orders page. Once an order enters fulfillment, it cannot be canceled and must be returned after delivery.

question: What warranty coverage is included with hardware products?
ground_truth: All hardware products include a 1-year limited manufacturer warranty covering defects in materials and craftsmanship.
contexts: Nexus hardware comes with a 1-year limited warranty against hardware defects from the date of retail purchase. Accidental damage or unauthorized modifications are not covered.

question: What should I do if my package arrived damaged?
ground_truth: If your package arrives damaged, take photos of the packaging and items and contact support within 48 hours to receive a free replacement or full refund.
contexts: For items damaged during transit, please report the issue within 48 hours of receipt. Submit clear photos of the packaging and damaged item to support@nexus.io for expedited replacement.

question: Do you offer international shipping, and are duties included?
ground_truth: We ship internationally to over 50 countries; customs duties and import taxes are calculated and collected at checkout so there are no surprise fees on delivery.
contexts: International shipping is available to over 50 supported countries. Customs duties, local taxes, and import tariffs are calculated at checkout (DDP - Delivery Duty Paid).

question: What payment methods are accepted on the platform?
ground_truth: We accept major credit cards (Visa, MasterCard, American Express), PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay.
contexts: Nexus accepts Visa, MasterCard, Discover, American Express, PayPal, Apple Pay, and Google Pay. We do not accept cash on delivery or personal checks.

question: How do I initiate a product exchange for a different size?
ground_truth: To exchange an item for a different size, visit our Returns Portal, select 'Exchange for different size', print the prepaid shipping label, and drop off the package.
contexts: Exchanges are free of charge. Visit returns.nexus.io, select your order, and choose 'Exchange Size'. A prepaid shipping label will be generated instantly.
